blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Revision points serve as quick summary notes for rapid final prep before competitive examinations.
Consolidates essential formulas, definitions, key dates, and core factual highlights.
Focuses on high-frequency questions and repeatedly tested patterns in national competitive exams.
Designed to strengthen active recall and minimize last-minute study fatigue.
Ensure all summary formulas and core definitions from final revision modules are memorized.
Pay special attention to frequently repeated facts, exceptions, and key dates in competitive exam papers.
Use active recall on revision points during the final 48 hours prior to the examination.
